project.name: Ultimate Bravery
project.summary: Random-build challenge site: rolls a champion, role, item order, summoner spells, runes and ability max order for Summoner's Rift (Live and Classic modes, also Wild Rift and TFT tabs) with seven self-enforced rules and shareable builds; also links LoLGuessr.
